title: anthyllis hermanniae subsp. hystrix
intro: Anthyllis hermanniae subsp. hystrix, commonly known as Kidney Vetch or Wood Broom, is a flowering plant species in the legume family (Fabaceae) that is native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Kidney Vetch include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, which can help alleviate conditions such as arthritis, respiratory issues, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Kidney Vetch include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
